final: WITH per_observatory AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS observatory_count, CAST(1 AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS average_share FROM per_observatory) SELECT AVG(p.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count, AVG(p.share) AS average_share, AVG(p.share - o.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM per_observatory p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.share > o.average_share
